entry.title: Rodsher Lighthouse
entry.note: +Y up; +Z panel wall approximately west, opposite -Z door approximately east. Origin is tower-foot center on host terrain. Official photo viewpoint on the western long keeper-house roof, with northwest hipped house to image-left, signs the panel/door opposition; approximate bearing, not surveyed north. The project supplies tower location and separate20m navigation-light height. Published survey mesh supplies relative body/lantern dimensions, including20.45m vane tip; its20.75m raw span includes rough ground. No surveyed north axis or EXIF compass was supplied. Solar-wall bearing270degrees true is a photo/context reconstruction with22.5degree uncertainty, not a precise engineering azimuth. OSM keeper-house polygons are contextual controls only, not a lighthouse footprint or part of this model. Clean survey-derived octagonal base is explicitly reconstructed geometry. Detached houses, natural granite shore, exact present paint decay and interior operation are omitted; footprint replacement stays off. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
